guitar.notes: Phil Collins is primarily a drummer/vocalist; Daryl Stuermer was his longtime touring guitarist, no single iconic documented model.

tone.target: dark 80s clean with gated room/reverb and sparse arpeggios
tone.profile: dark 80s clean with gated room/reverb and sparse arpeggios
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing compression for attack definition, followed by a clean Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) paired with a small cabinet. The signature 'In the Air Tonight' sound is achieved using a Plate reverb combined with a Gate to simulate the dramatic gated ambience and sparse arpeggios.

rig.name: Phil Collins - In The Air Tonight - Valeton GP-180
